executive_summary: Wrote a full (greenfield) specification for Job Hunt CRM defining WHAT must be true post-change across 4 domains: Applications CRUD (record shape + per-user RLS isolation), Stage lifecycle & promotion (canonical stage set applied→screened→interview→offer + terminal rejected, forward-order promotion, +7-day follow-up scheduling), Follow-up reminders (due detection follow_up_date<=today, next-follow-ups list, daily 9am summary cron), and Pipeline analytics (per-stage count/%, avg days-in-stage, canonical key shape). Reconciled proposal/design/tasks inconsistencies into authoritative contracts and recorded the remaining choice (ORM) as an implementation-decision risk for design/tasks.
next_recommended: route to sdd-tasks (or design) to reconcile the ORM decision (TypeORM vs Prisma) and align design.md Mongoose-style snippets with the spec's canonical stage/source enums and data semantics.
risks: ORM choice unresolved: design.md mixes Mongoose findByIdAndUpdate/$push, TypeORM mention, and Prisma-style Promise<T>. Spec pins behavior-level semantics only; design/tasks MUST pick ONE ORM and fix the service snippets.

Stage enum reconciliation: pinned applied|screened|interview|offer|rejected; rejected is terminal (not a Kanban column). UI/tasks listed only 4 active stages. Confirmed by spec but tasks/design must implement rejected specifically as out-of-board.
Source enum pinned linkedin|indeed|referral|other (added 'other' vs proposal's 3 values); tasks/design seed data and DTOs must include 'other'.
Analytics legacy keys 'interviewing'/'offers' in design sketch replaced with canonical 'interview'/'offer'; design/tasks must update the PipelineStats type/response shape.

Avg days-in-stage for non-applied stages depends on stage-entry timestamps not in the current data model; spec makes applied-stage days-in-stage MUST and others SHOULD (labeled), flagged for design to decide whether to track stage-entry timestamps.

avgDaysInStage in original design sketch is a single number vs. design acceptance showing per-stage; spec pins single top-level avgDaysInStage (applied days-in-stage) plus per-stage counts/percentages.
